messages:
ria_sales: Heads up — need deal-desk + finance sign-off for NimbusCorp. They want a private deployment (VPC + SOC2), 2yr commit, asking for 40% off list in year 1. ARR ~ $1.2M. Also asking for migration credits. Can we approve?

dealbot: New deal request created: DD-2026-0453 — assigned to john_revops :spiral_calendar: (automated)
john_revops: Quick facts: what's the net ARR and gross margin at 40%? Need numbers to move to legal.
sam_engineer: On private deploy ops: estimated infra + SRE uplift ~ $220k/yr. SOC2 support & evidence gating ~ $30k/yr. No hidden license fees.
maria_finance: 40% drops our margin way too low — approx margin in single digits after infra. Can't approve as-is. Need alternative concession structure.
olivia_sales: Customer is pushing hard on price and has a competing quote. Sales walkaway threshold is 30% — above that they'll likely walk. We can trade non-price items.
ara_security: We'll need completed security questionnaire + SOC2 docs before go-live. KMS + SSO requirements will be contract conditions. Legal needs that before private deploy ship.
john_revops: Proposal: 30% + $50k migration credit, tied to a 2yr commit at $1.5M ARR and milestone ramp (90 days). If finance ok, I'll mark approved.
maria_finance: Run the math first. If 30% + $50k credit + 2yr $1.5M commit holds margin above our floor, I can provisionally approve. No permanent reduction to list beyond yr1 without review.
ria_sales: Customer says 30% is the absolute max they can accept. They'll take our standard renewal review after yr1. SOC2 timeline requirement: 3 months.
john_revops: Price calc snippet (for clarity):
```
List ARR = $1,200,000
30% discount = $360,000
Migration credit = $50,000 (one-time)
Net ARR Y1 = $1,200,000 - $360,000 - $50,000 = $790,000
Estimated infra+ops Y1 = $250,000
Estimated gross margin Y1 ~= (790k - 250k) / 790k = ~68% (pre-overheads)
```
maria_finance: That margin looks acceptable relative to our target once commit is increased to $1.5M over 2yrs. Approve 30% + $50k migration credit conditional on: 1) 2yr $1.5M committed ARR, 2) SOC2 evidence within 90 days, 3) finance final signoff on contract. :white_check_mark:
olivia_sales: I'll present 30% + $50k credit + 2yr commit to the buyer and push SOC2 gating. If they accept, I need RevOps to update DD ticket and Legal to add KMS/SSO clause.
john_revops: Roger — marking DD-2026-0453 as PENDING-FINANCE and tagging legal. @ara_security please coordinate docs.
ara_security: On it — will ping legal for contract language and request customer's SOC2 report.
ria_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll reconvene after customer reply.
dealbot: DD-2026-0453 status updated -> PENDING-FINANCE by john_revops
note: This thread captures a concise sales-deal approval flow: price ask, cost inputs, alternative concession, and conditional approval.
